title: Ten Questions · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Ten Questions · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: The lead writes down a familiar animal, place or object without showing it. The others ask up to ten yes-or-no questions and then make one guess. The final guess matches the written answer. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Ten Questions, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The final guess matches the written answer.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The final guess matches the written answer.
